Revenue 1,102,459 less the printed cost of sales 388,464 equals the printed gross profit 713,995. Administrative expenses are the printed 1,058,046. The filing then prints an operating profit before tax and interest of 327,949, which includes other income of 672,000 thousand naira that the panel has no row for, so the printed 327,949 is stored as Operating Profit (EBIT). Less the printed finance cost 314,743 equals the printed profit before tax 13,206, and the filing charges no income tax for the year so the profit for the year is the same 13,206 and no income tax row is written.
